messages:
sarah (oncall): incident-bot just paged me: spike in 5xx + failovers in eu-west, seeing huge retry amplification. anyone else seeing this?
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED • ID INC-2026-8843 • Severity: P2 • triggered by: routing-fallback-policy-errors • paged: sarah (oncall) • channel: #incidents
ops-bot: autopilot detected +180% attempt rate to fallback model variants in eu-west, rolling average errors 5xx -> 12% (15m) :warning:
mike (infra-sre): on it. early hypothesis: smart-routing fallback policy matched wrong variant (v2-small) in eu region causing degraded latency, clients retried -> cascade.
carol (prod-eng): confirming — logs show policy rule arn:smart:fallback:eu:match(client_pref=low_latency) accidentally matched model-tag "v2-small" instead of v2-xla. recent policy deploy 2638519001 changed priority.
sarah (oncall): impact? which customers? severity?
customer-support: affected tenants: 12 high-qps customers (PLG + three enterprise). Errors surfaced in SDK v1.4.2 with default retry=3. Observable user-facing timeouts and elevated token costs.
jeremy (platform): traffic numbers: fallback route traffic jumped from 3% -> 48% of eu-west requests after 12:04 UTC. client retries doubled retry traffic within 30s window.
elaine (sre): we're seeing thundering herd on dedicated pools for v2-small causing OOMs and queueing, mean latency 2.6s -> 12s, 99p -> 32s.
sarah (oncall): paging PD now and escalating to infra-sre. mike, can you temp disable fallback policy?
mike (infra-sre): doing now. disabling policy smart-fallback-eu-v2...
<mike (infra-sre) pasted code block>
```
# disable fallback policy
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/policies/disable" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"policy_id":"smart-fallback-eu-v2"}'
```
ops-bot: policy smart-fallback-eu-v2 disabled (api: /policies/disable) — change id: ch_2638520021
mike (infra-sre): disabled, pushing a temporary route to force stable variant v2-xla in eu-west for traffic > 20rps per tenant.
<mike (infra-sre) pasted code block>
```
# temporary route override
PATCH /routing/overrides/263852
{ "region":"eu-west", "force_variant":"v2-xla", "match":"tenant_qps>20" }
```
carol (prod-eng): confirming route override applied, see: https://console.internal/routing/overrides/263852 status=active
incident-bot: change rolled, wait 30s for propagation.
jeremy (platform): rolling back the policy deploy 2638519001 to previous version to be safe.
<mike (infra-sre)>: also adding a short-term token bucket throttle for retries per-tenant to prevent client amplification: rate_limit.retries=2/30s.
sarah (oncall): quick customer comms: @customer-support please notify top 12 impacted customers that we mitigated routing issue and will follow up with RCA.
customer-support: notified customers via status and targeted emails, holding list of customers who asked for call.
elaine (sre): metrics trending better — fallback traffic down from 48% -> 6% in 120s, error rate falling back to baseline. 99p latency 32s -> 3.4s.
carol (prod-eng): root-cause so far: policy priority inversion during recent policy changes + missing unit test covering variant-tag equality. when fallback triggered, variant chosen was resource-constrained v2-small.
mike (infra-sre): mitigation summary: disabled smart-fallback-eu-v2, applied route override to v2-xla, applied retry throttling, rolled back policy deploy. scaled up v2-small pools to drain queued work and avoid OOMs.
sarah (oncall): handoff: mike (infra-sre) will continue immediate mitigation for next 2h, carol will lead RCA, jeremy will own policy tests and rollout gating. I'll open a postmortem and assign owners.
incident-bot: PAGED: infra-sre oncall, escalation step: oncall->secondary (mike)
mike (infra-sre): I'm pairing with ops to watch for residual retry amplification. adding extra tracing on request_id and retry_count.
carol (prod-eng): temp measure: adding stricter match rules so only variants with size >= xla get chosen for routing.policy fallback queue. adding unit + integration tests in policy service.
jeremy (platform): planning: add canary deploys for policy updates + automated policy hypothesis tests that simulate client retries.
sarah (oncall): estimated customer impact window: 12:03 UTC -> 12:08 UTC (about 5 minutes of heavy failover & retry amplification), with degraded user ops continuing until 12:12 UTC for some tenants.
customer-support: all impacted customers listed, emails sent, 3 customers requested follow-up calls and we scheduled them.
elaine (sre): monitoring: setting alert for fallback-% > 10% per region and retry amplification factor > 1.5.
carol (prod-eng): postmortem owners and timeline: RCA doc assigned to carol, due EOD tomorrow; mitigation runbook updates assigned to jeremy; infra follow-up (pool sizing + graceful degrade) assigned to mike.
sarah (oncall): closing incident in channel once monitoring stable for 30m. thanks team. :heart:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED • ID INC-2026-8843 • resolved_by: team • resolved_at: 2638520620
carol (prod-eng): quick note for postmortem: include example logs, policy diff, and synthetic test showing retry amplification multiplier.
mike (infra-sre): arch note: consider circuit-breaker before failover to avoid immediate failover doubling traffic.
jeremy (platform): will add automated policy lint preventing variant-tag collisions.
sarah (oncall): end of thread — I'll file the RCA and link here. good job everyone. :thumbsup:
